Mithril: approximately +4 strength with Mithril and Mithril Working. Only the strongest available metal tier applies; this promotion marks eligibility, not the current metal.]

civilopediaText.text: This unit is eligible for metal weapon bonuses. Bronze Working and connected Copper grant roughly +1 strength; Iron Working and connected Iron grant roughly +2; Mithril Working and connected Mithril grant roughly +4. Only the best available tier applies. The icon marks equipment eligibility, not the metal currently equipped. Combat bonuses change dynamically with access to metals.

name: Fire I
uniques: Only available <with [Fire Mana]>
Can instantly construct a [Smoke] improvement <for all movement> <with [Fire Mana]>

civilopediaText.text: Requires Channeling I and access to Fire Mana when learned. Allows Blaze: ignite an eligible unimproved forest or jungle tile by constructing Smoke on the caster's tile. Casting consumes all movement, but not the caster. Unlike EMM, Unciv does not simulate spreading fire or automatic Smoke expiration.

name: Hasted
uniques: [+1] Movement
Not shown on world screen

civilopediaText.text: Temporary +1 movement status from Body I Haste. Its duration expires automatically. This effect is not a selectable promotion.

name: Body I
uniques: Only available <with [Body Mana]>
[This Unit] gains the [Hasted] status for [2] turn(s) <for all movement> <with [Body Mana]>

civilopediaText.text: Body I requires Channeling I and access to Body Mana when learning the promotion. Cast Haste to grant the caster the Hasted (+1 Movement) status for 2 turns by spending all current movement. Standard Unciv unit action targeting cannot reproduce EMM's group-wide friendly-unit Haste effect, nor automatic Slow removal.

name: Water I
uniques: Only available <with [Water Mana]>
Turn this tile into a [Plains] tile <for all movement> <with [Water Mana]> <in [Desert] tiles> <in [your] tiles> <in [unimproved] tiles> <in tiles without [Flood plains]>
Remove [Smoke] improvements from this tile <for all movement> <with [Water Mana]> <in [Smoke] tiles> <in [your] tiles>

civilopediaText.text: Water I (Channeling I; Water Mana required) grants Spring: on an owned unimproved Desert tile without Flood plains, use its terrain conversion action to turn the tile to Plains, spending all movement. It can also extinguish a Smoke improvement beneath the caster as a separate action. Unlike EMM's Spring, smoke removal does not extend to adjacent tiles; terrain-changing on improved, foreign, and Flood plains tiles is disabled for safety.

name: Enchanted Blade Aura
uniques: [20]% Strength bonus for [Sword] units within [1] tiles
Not shown on world screen

civilopediaText.text: Temporary Enchanted Blade approximation. Friendly Sword-class units within one tile of the caster receive +20% Strength while the aura is active; the bonus disappears when the status expires or they leave the area. EMM instead grants a removable lasting Enchanted Blade promotion to friendly melee units and cures Rusted.

name: Enchantment I
uniques: Only available <with [Enchantment Mana]>
[This Unit] gains the [Enchanted Blade Aura] status for [2] turn(s) <for all movement> <with [Enchantment Mana]>

civilopediaText.text: Requires Channeling I and Enchantment Mana. Cast Enchanted Blade to grant the caster a 2-turn aura that gives friendly Sword-class troops within one tile +20% combat Strength. Casting costs all movement; the caster survives. This is a deliberately temporary proximity-based approximation, not EMM's permanent melee-unit Enchanted Blade promotion or Rusted removal.

name: Treetop Tactics
uniques: [+10]% Strength <when fighting in [Forest] tiles>
Not shown on world screen

civilopediaText.text: Temporary forest-combat enhancement granted by Nature I. +10% Strength when fighting in Forest tiles. EMM additionally grants withdrawal chance, boosts Ancient Forest fighting more strongly, and can benefit other valid friendly units; these are not simulated in the current mod-only implementation.

name: Nature I
uniques: Only available <with [Nature Mana]>
[This Unit] gains the [Treetop Tactics] status for [2] turn(s) <for all movement> <with [Nature Mana]> <in [Forest] tiles>

civilopediaText.text: Requires Channeling I and Nature Mana. Cast Treetop Tactics while standing in Forest to gain a two-turn temporary +10% Strength bonus when fighting on Forest tiles. Casting consumes all movement but not the caster or Mana. This is a self-cast approximation of EMM's forest-limited Treetop Tactics spell.

name: Inspiration (Spell)
uniques: Gain [2] [Science] <upon turn start> <in [City center] tiles> <with [Mind Mana]>
Not shown on world screen

civilopediaText.text: Temporary Inspiration effect, cast by a Mind I arcane unit. At the start of each turn, while this unit is stationed on a city-center tile and the civilization still has Mind Mana, gain 2 empire Science. No Science is gained while outside a city center. EMM instead creates a city building providing 2 beakers and 1 Great Sage point per turn; the Great Sage point is not represented in this mod-only implementation.

name: Mind I
uniques: Only available <with [Mind Mana]>
[This Unit] gains the [Inspiration (Spell)] status for [2] turn(s) <for all movement> <with [Mind Mana]> <in [City center] tiles>

civilopediaText.text: Requires Channeling I and Mind Mana. Cast Inspiration while stationed in any city center, spending all movement but keeping the caster. Inspiration grants a 2-turn status that produces +2 Science at turn start only while the caster remains in a city center; recast to maintain. Unlike EMM's sustained city building, its science is credited to the empire rather than listed as a city building yield, and Great Sage points are not generated.

name: Courage (Spell)
uniques: All adjacent units heal [10] HP when healing
Not shown on world screen

civilopediaText.text: Spirit I Courage approximation: for two turns, friendly adjacent units gain +10 HP when healing. EMM grants a Courage promotion to friendly eligible units on the caster's tile, with +10 same-tile healing, fear immunity and +5 exploration result bonus. Fear immunity, exploration bonus, same-tile targeting and EMM expiration chance are not reproduced.

name: Spirit I
uniques: Only available <with [Spirit Mana]>
[This Unit] gains the [Courage (Spell)] status for [2] turn(s) <for all movement> <with [Spirit Mana]>

civilopediaText.text: Cast Courage: a temporary two-turn healing aura on this caster, providing +10 healing to adjacent units while they heal. EMM applies an individually removable Courage promotion to units on the caster's tile instead. Mana is required to learn and cast; moving away from the caster loses the proxy aura.
